tasks: Match 'Searching' (खोज रहे हैं) to 'Looking for something'.
hints: Think about what Papa wears on his nose to read. (सोचें कि पापा पढ़ने के लिए नाक पर क्या पहनते हैं।)
It is an action when you have lost something. (यह एक क्रिया है जब आप कुछ खो देते हैं।)

scaffolding_levels.type: Fill in the Blanks (रिक्त स्थान भरें)
tasks: Papa looked for his spectacles on the _________ and under the _________.
Finally, he found them resting on his own _________!
hints: Places in the room where things are kept. (कमरे में वे स्थान जहाँ चीजें रखी जाती हैं।)
Touch the top of your body. (अपने शरीर के सबसे ऊपरी हिस्से को छुएं।)

tasks: Why was Papa searching for his spectacles? (पापा अपना चश्मा क्यों ढूँढ रहे थे?)
Where did he find them at last? (उन्हें अंत में वे कहाँ मिले?)
hints: Can a person read clearly without them if they need them? (क्या कोई व्यक्ति उनके बिना स्पष्ट रूप से पढ़ सकता है यदि उन्हें उनकी आवश्यकता है?)
It was a funny place because they were with him all along. (यह एक मज़ेदार जगह थी क्योंकि वे पूरे समय उनके साथ थे।)
